properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 11 at 1:03AM CDT until September 11 at 1:15AM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
At 103 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
near Cairo to 7 miles northwest of Clinton, moving northeast at 35
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Wyatt and Wilson City.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 11 at 1:02AM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
At 102 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from over Cairo to near Bardwell, moving
northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Cairo, La Center, Wickliffe, Barlow, Kevil, Wilson City and
Blandville.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 11 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Little Rock AR
properties.description:
At 1259 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Lynn, or 9 miles west of Lake Charles State Park, moving east at 35
mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Pocahontas...                     Walnut Ridge...
Hoxie...                          Black Rock...
Lake Charles State Park...        Swifton...
Imboden...                        Ravenden...
College City...                   Portia...
Strawberry...                     Lynn...
O'Kean...                         Alicia...
Minturn...                        Annieville...
Sedgwick...                       Smithville...
Powhatan...                       Strangers Home...
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 1:41AM EDT until September 11 at 3:30AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
At 141 AM EDT, emergency management reported high water making US 33
near Glenville impassible in multiple locations due to prior heavy
rainfall. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen. Flash
flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by prior heavy rain.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Glenville, Grantsville, Tanner, Burnt House, Big Springs, Newberne,
Coxs Mills, Troy, Annamoriah, Baldwin and Linn.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Report flooding to the National Weather Service by calling toll free,
800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.
properties.area: Calhoun, WV; Gilmer, WV; Ritchie, WV

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From Sunday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Thursday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.

feet on 11/24/1997.
